data.value: Everything you need to know about tournaments, teams and payments. Can't find an answer? Write to us.

data.name: FaqQ1
data.value: How do I create an account?

data.name: FaqA1
data.value: Click “Register” in the top right corner and enter your first name, last name, email and a password. The password must be at least 8 characters long and contain an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number and a symbol.

data.name: FaqQ2
data.value: I forgot my password. What should I do?

data.name: FaqA2
data.value: On the login page click “Forgot password?” and enter your email. You will receive a link for setting a new password. If the email doesn't arrive, check your spam folder too.

data.name: FaqQ3
data.value: How do I change my password?

data.name: FaqA3
data.value: Open “My Profile” and click “Change password”. Enter your current password and the new one.

data.name: FaqQ4
data.value: How do I change the site language?

data.name: FaqA4
data.value: Use the globe button in the top menu and choose “Български” or “English”. Your choice is remembered.

data.name: FaqQ5
data.value: How do I find a tournament near me?

data.name: FaqA5
data.value: Open “Cities”, pick your city and click “Tournaments”. You will see current and upcoming tournaments, and past ones under “Finished”.

data.name: FaqQ6
data.value: How many teams can play in one tournament?

data.name: FaqA6
data.value: Up to 16 teams. When a tournament is full, registration closes automatically.

data.name: FaqQ7
data.value: Can I take part in several tournaments at the same time?

data.name: FaqA7
data.value: As a coach you can take part in only one active tournament. To join another one, leave the current tournament first or wait until it ends.

data.name: FaqQ8
data.value: Can I withdraw from a tournament?

data.name: FaqA8
data.value: Yes. Go to “Participation → As Coach” and click “Leave tournament”. This is possible only before the tournament starts. Leaving does not refund the fee automatically – contact the organizers for a refund.

data.name: FaqQ9
data.value: How do I register a team for a tournament?

data.name: FaqA9
data.value: Open the tournament and click “Join Tournament”. If you are not a coach yet, you first fill in a short form with your name and years of experience. Then you enter the team name and players, accept the declaration and pay the fee.

data.name: FaqQ10
data.value: How many players does a team need?

data.name: FaqA10
data.value: Between 6 and 10 players. The team name must be 3 to 15 characters long and must not match another team's name.

data.name: FaqQ11
data.value: Can I be both a coach and a referee?

data.name: FaqA11
data.value: No. An account is either a coach or a referee. You can give up your role in “My Profile”.

data.name: FaqQ12
data.value: How do I pay the participation fee?

data.name: FaqA12
data.value: After accepting the declaration you are taken to Stripe's secure payment page and pay by card. Your team is registered right after a successful payment and you get a notification.

data.name: FaqA13
data.value: Yes. The payment is handled entirely by Stripe, one of the world's largest payment providers. The site never sees or stores your card details.

data.name: FaqQ14
data.value: I paid but my team isn't registered. What happened?

data.name: FaqA14
data.value: If your team can't be registered after the payment (for example, the tournament filled up in the meantime), the amount is refunded to your card automatically and you get a notification. If you see neither a registration nor a notification, write to us.

data.name: FaqA15
data.value: Refunds are handled by the organizers. If you leave a tournament, the fee is not refunded automatically – write to us via “Contact the organizers” and mention your team and tournament. If you later rejoin the same tournament, you don't pay again. You will receive an email once the amount is refunded. If a tournament is cancelled (for example because not enough teams signed up), the fee is refunded automatically to the card you paid with.

data.name: FaqQ16
data.value: Will I be charged twice if I click “Pay” again?

data.name: FaqA16
data.value: No. If you already have a payment in progress, the site takes you back to it, and if you have already paid for the tournament, a second payment is not possible.

data.name: FaqQ17
data.value: How do I become a referee?

data.name: FaqA17
data.value: Open a tournament that has no referee yet and click “Become A Referee”. You must be at least 18 years old and have at least 2 years of experience. You can referee only one tournament at a time.

data.name: FaqQ18
data.value: How do I rate a referee?

data.name: FaqA18
data.value: On the “Referees” page choose 1 to 5 stars under the referee's card and click “Save”. Under “Comments” you can also leave a review.

data.name: FaqQ19
data.value: How does the tournament bracket work?

data.name: FaqA19
data.value: Tournaments are knockout competitions: round of 16, quarter-finals, semi-finals and the final. The winner of each match moves on. With fewer than 16 teams, the teams without an opponent in the first round go straight through. The bracket is on the “Tournament Details” page.

data.name: FaqQ20
data.value: Can a match end in a draw?

data.name: FaqA20
data.value: No. Every match must have a winner who moves on to the next round.

data.name: FaqA21
data.value: The organizers enter the result after each match and it appears in the tournament bracket straight away.

data.name: FaqA22
data.value: A ranking of the teams in a city by the number of wins they have there. Open “Cities” and click “City Leaders” for the city you want.

data.name: FaqA23
data.value: You get a notification after a successful payment, when a new tournament is created in a city where you have played before, about 24 hours before your tournament starts, and when the organizers reply to you. Some notifications are also sent by email.

data.name: FaqQ24
data.value: How can I suggest a tournament in my city?

data.name: FaqA24
data.value: Log in and write to us via “Contact the organizers” (the link is at the bottom of every page). You will see the reply in your notifications.

data.name: FaqQ25
data.value: Where can I see photos from the tournaments?

data.name: FaqA25
data.value: Open “Cities → Tournaments → Finished” and click “Gallery” for the tournament you want.
